entry_schema.entry_scope: WHOLE_PROJECT_WITH_TYPED_SUBWORKSTREAMS when a project has concurrent Current lanes
entry_schema.current_owner_scope: scope note preventing one live-object owner from being misread as sole whole-project owner
entry_schema.current_native_master: canonical master reference or explicit NONE_ON_MAIN boundary
entry_schema.whole_project_workstreams: Current project workstreams with project role, state, automation route, evidence, gap and next action
entry_schema.production_queue_role: optional declaration that a child production queue is subordinate rather than the whole project
entry_schema.production_cursor: optional child-item cursor; separates returned/current/waiting items across bounded owners
entry_schema.design_subtask_current_item: current child item for DESIGN when a production cursor is used
entry_schema.design_subtask_last_returned_item: most recent child item returned by DESIGN
entry_schema.design_current_execution_state: optional current child execution-plane state distinct from lease/cursor state
entry_schema.design_current_execution_evidence: optional readback evidence for the current DESIGN child
entry_schema.design_current_return_gate: optional unresolved gate that prevents cursor advance despite machine success
entry_schema.validation_subtask_current_item: current child item for VALIDATION when a production cursor is used
entry_schema.presentation_subtask_current_item: current child item waiting for/under PRESENTATION consumption
entry_schema.lease_contract: governance contract reference when lease is present
entry_schema.shared_blender_runtime: repository-wide Blender runtime authority when applicable
entry_schema.production_stall: optional governance stall classification or null
entry_schema.production_stall_basis: evidence basis or explicit correction basis for a production stall classification
entry_schema.source_of_queue_decision: project Current State or explicit user instruction
